Subject: Flight pooling and hotel split — Portland roadshow handovers

Team — putting the travel + rooming plan for the Portland roadshow on your radar. We're at the point where several late cancellations and two delayed flights mean we need to pool passengers and split the hotel block across two properties to avoid overbooking the CityHotel block. Key asks below; I've attached the working itinerary and rooming chart.

Quick summary:
- Event dates: June 12–14 (booth setup on the 11th)
- Primary hotel: CityHotel Portland — 42 rooms on hold
- Secondary hotel (overflow): Riverfront Inn — 18 rooms (booked by ops)
- Flights: 6 passengers on late-night redeye and 4 who need earlier arrivals

Immediate asks (please reply inline):
1) Marissa — can you confirm which two SDRs you want swapped from the redeye to the 10:05am flight? We need earlier coverage at 8:30am badge pick.
2) Alex — I last saw your pooling spreadsheet. Can you update seat assignments and shuttle groups by noon?
3) Mina — please confirm final rooming chart changes and whether CityHotel can do late check-in for the four arrivals after midnight.
4) Dylan — you're on onsite lead for arrival handoffs; can you scope a quick badge pickup plan and shuttle manifest?

Attachments: itinerary_master_v2.xlsx (master schedule), hotel_rooming_chart.pdf (proposed split), badge_rollcall.csv (current list).

Notes on contingencies:
- If CityHotel confirms only 36 rooms at check-in, we'll push six folks to Riverfront (15-minute shuttle). Ops will cover taxi reimbursement for anyone moved.
- Backup: if the 10:05am flight is oversold, we have one standby confirmed on United 8:30am (Dylan will carry the backup passenger name).

Thanks — trying to lock this by EOD so we can send final travel confirmations to Jared and the Innovacorp team.

— Camila

3) Mina — please confirm late check-in; if CityHotel can't, move Priya to Riverfront and Noah to CityHotel (we'll stagger).

I'll update the internal standby list and ping Ops to hold reimbursement approvals.
